column3: US-01 Register and log in with email or Google

As a user, I want to answer a short style quiz: styles, colours, occasions.

As a user, I want to set my usual dress code and a modest preference.

Acceptance criteria: One of the 5 levels; with modest on, no non-modest piece appears anywhere

Use case: UC-02 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

As a user, I want to set my city so outfits use my local weather.

Acceptance criteria: Forecast on Home is for that city

Use case: UC-02 · MoSCoW: Must · Release: S1

column4:
